speaker: john_harrison
text: Master Shakespeare. You come on a good morning. I have the leaf, if Richard will let it out of his hand.

speaker: richard_field
text: He may have it standing. That is how he reads.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will stand. The jaw is the size it was yesterday, and a stool will not mend it.

speaker: john_harrison
text: There. The margin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is very small.

speaker: john_harrison
text: There is a Cambridge gentleman calls you sweet, Master Shakespeare. I have told two customers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Two, and the forenoon is young. The Lucrece is… respected.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Respected is a quiet word. Let me see the quiet of this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sweet Shakspeare. Two words, and the rest of the leaf is too small to take.

speaker: richard_field
text: Read them again, standing. That is what I brought thee for.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have read them. I have read the names above and the names under. I am still between them.

speaker: richard_field
text: For the poems, mark. Not for a king in Shoreditch, nor a boy under a wall. Thou'rt wasted on players.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The king is the work of this month, Richard. I am not wasted on what pays the week.

speaker: richard_field
text: A player is spent on the day he is played. Thou knowest this.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I know what the margin says. I am not buying the book to know it twice.

speaker: john_harrison
text: You need not buy it. I have told two customers, and the leaf may stay open for a third if he looks like money.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it open, then. I have it by heart, which is a cheaper binding.

speaker: richard_field
text: Shut it gently. It is Harrison's stock.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Gently, then.

speaker: richard_field
text: And thou wilt not spend the morning on my Holinshed either. I asked yesterday. I heard God keep thee, and I did not hear the book.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cat has it, Richard. Today is a margin, not a shelf.

speaker: john_harrison
text: Two customers, Master Shakespeare. I do not waste a good name on a slow morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then spend it. I have spent nothing, and I am keeping it so.

speaker: richard_field
text: God keep thee, Will. And mend thy face before thou standest in a shop again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God keep you, Master Harrison. Tomorrow I am played, not read.
